summary: "Gecko Media Plugins (GMP) got a cleanup around startup, shutdown, and validation so third-party media plugins used for DRM and protected content initialize more reliably. Firefox now waits for plugin registration, handles the plugin thread going away cleanly, and verifies plugin versions and node IDs before allowing them to run. This matters for services that rely on Widevine or similar protected-streaming technology, because it reduces crashes and security problems when content is decrypted or decoded."
